info.title: Gubanov Files API
info.description: Unofficial JSON endpoints behind gubanovfiles.com ("Files of Gubanov"), a database of bloggers and outlets that published promotional material about the 'SEZ PPT Alabuga' project. Knowledge comes from the community Swift client https://github.com/l0v3m0n3y/gubanovfiles (src/gubanovfiles.swift lists the three routes) and from live GET probes on 2026-10-23; the site publishes no documentation of its own. Response shapes are taken from those probes. Unverified: `/statuses` returned an empty object, so its contents are unknown; no pagination or query parameters were observed on any route. No key is needed.

get.description: Returns every recorded mention (23 on 2026-10-23), each with Russian, English and Ukrainian text.
Returns a single object mapping Telegram handles to avatar image URLs. The response is large (~3.3 MB).
Returns a statuses object. Observed as `{}` on 2026-10-23.

Mention.description: A recorded mention of the Alabuga SEZ project by a blogger or outlet.

id.description: Mention id, e.g. `item-makashenets-2026` or a random 20-character id.

sourceUrl.description: Link to the original material (YouTube video, Telegram post, article).

sourceName.description: Name of the blogger or outlet (Russian).

title.description: Title in the original language (usually Russian).

content.description: Summary text in the original language.

date.description: Publication date, ISO 8601 at midnight UTC, e.g. `2026-07-17T00:00:00Z`.

title_ru.description: Russian title. Present on only some mentions (6 of 23 on 2026-10-23).

content_ru.description: Russian summary. Present on only some mentions (6 of 23 on 2026-10-23).

Avatar.description: Map from a Telegram handle (e.g. `@olegtsarov`) or, for private channels, a 16-character invite hash, to the URL of that channel's avatar image (all observed values were `https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/...` URLs). 14,307 entries (~3.3 MB) on 2026-10-23.

Status.description: Statuses map. The endpoint answered with an empty object `{}` on 2026-10-23, so the key and value types are unknown.
